description: Self-improving loop core (engine layer, stdlib). Evidence log, versioned learned-config registry, proposal builders, regression gate over frozen sets, conditional priors, perception overlay.
steps: Create backend/intelligence/learning_engine/loop.py (export from __init__). EvidenceLog: append-only JSONL file (or in-memory) with id, injected timestamp, kind in {role_correction, hypothesis_feedback, experiment_outcome, mapping_edit}, payload, provenance 'user' or 'experiment'. Validate: role must be in intelligence.schemas.ROLES, term is 1-4 lowercase alpha words, feedback decision in the annotations DECISIONS set. Reject invalid input with ValueError; never store simulation results as real_world.

LearnedConfig versions in a ModelRegistry (JSON file in a directory, atomic write via temp file + os.replace): each version has id, parent, created (injected clock), config = {lexicon_overlay: {term: role}, priors: [{key, conditions, n, accepted, rejected, value}]}, evidence_ids, status in {active, rejected, rolled_back, superseded}, gate report. Version 0 is the empty config. Methods: active(), propose(...), activate, rollback(to=parent by default, records an audit entry), history(), diff(a,b). Append-only audit.jsonl records every propose, accept, reject, rollback with reason.

Proposal builders use ONLY the evidence log. Lexicon: a term enters the overlay only with >= 2 corrections from distinct runs (or distinct events) and >= 80% agreement on one role; conflicting evidence is recorded as 'conflict' and not learned. Leak guard: terms that occur in data/benchmark_problems/perception_heldout.json phrases, heldout_labels.json or benchmarks.json query text are quarantined (not added) and recorded as 'heldout_overlap'. The held-out files are read ONLY by the gate and this guard, never to derive a role. Priors: from hypothesis_feedback and experiment_outcome evidence, grouped by (concept_type, conditions such as query_domain); a prior needs n >= 3, value = bounded shrunk estimate within [-0.1, 0.1] (reuse the existing cap), and stores its conditions and n.

Gate: run_gate(candidate_config) computes metrics for active vs candidate: perception role_accuracy, precision_when_assigned, detection_recall (import the logic from scripts/evaluate_perception.py or, better, move the evaluate function into a backend module such as backend/intelligence/learning_engine/gate.py that the script also uses without changing its output), held-out retrieval mrr_strong and ndcg_at_10 (scripts/evaluate_heldout.py run()), tuning MRR (scripts/evaluate_benchmarks.py run()). Reject the candidate if ANY metric is lower than active by more than 1e-9; record the full before/after table in the version gate report and audit log. Accept only if no metric drops. Report honestly when a candidate is metric-neutral ('gate not sensitive to this change'), especially for priors, since priors do not enter the retrieval metrics. Make the scripts importable from backend code without duplicating logic (e.g. by moving shared code into backend and keeping thin script wrappers with identical output).

Perception overlay: add an optional `overlay: Optional[Dict[str,str]]` argument to perceive_text (default None keeps current behaviour exactly; held-out perception numbers must be unchanged with no overlay). Implement without global mutable state leaks (contextvar or explicit threading through resolve_unknown_role). Overlay terms are consulted first in resolve_unknown_role (before head_noun/morphology/knowledge_index), singular/plural normalised, matching the head word or whole phrase, with a new role_source 'learned' (add to ROLE_SOURCE_CONFIDENCE ~0.6 and ROLE_SOURCE_TEXT, mention the config version id in the inference text). Overlay must not override direct lexicon hits.

Conditional priors: change MemoryStore.prior_adjustment(concept_type, conditions=None) so that when conditions are given only records whose conditions match are used and fewer than 3 matching records returns 0.0; keep default behaviour backward compatible for existing tests. In pipeline.investigate accept an optional `learned` (active LearnedConfig) argument, pass overlay into perceive_text and conditional priors (matching the run's query_domain) into the concept sort. Priors never apply outside their recorded conditions. Add `learned_version` to the investigate result.

Tests (backend/tests/intelligence/test_learning_loop.py) with injected clock and tmp_path: evidence validation; two distinct corrections create a lexicon candidate and one does not; conflicting corrections are not learned; held-out overlap term is quarantined; gate accepts a metric-neutral or improving candidate on real data; gate REJECTS a deliberately harmful candidate (e.g. overlay mapping a word that the held-out set uses to a wrong role is not possible via leak guard, so construct the harmful candidate by calling run_gate directly with a bad overlay) and the rejection is recorded in audit and active version is unchanged; rollback restores the parent config and is audited; versions persist across registry instances; priors respect conditions and the n>=3 minimum; perceive_text with overlay yields role_source 'learned' on a new word and unchanged output with no overlay; a determinism test; a test that perception held-out numbers with the active empty config equal the current published numbers (0.404 accuracy).
acceptance_criteria: New tests pass and the full suite still passes
evaluate_perception.py, evaluate_heldout.py and evaluate_benchmarks.py print the same numbers as baseline.json when no learned config is active
A harmful candidate is rejected and recorded; the active version is unchanged
Learned priors carry conditions and n, and are not applied outside those conditions
No file under data/benchmark_problems is modified
verification: python3 scripts/evaluate_perception.py && python3 scripts/evaluate_heldout.py && python3 scripts/evaluate_benchmarks.py
git diff --stat -- data/benchmark_problems must be empty
